occurrences.quote: The claim is FALSE. While Back to the Future: The Ride was previously at Universal Studios Florida (now replaced by The Simpsons Ride), and The Simpsons Ride exists at both Florida and Hollywood locations, the specific relationship of being "adjacent to Springfield" only applies to the Universal Studios Hollywood location. The claim is FALSE. While Back to the Future: The Ride was formerly at Universal Studios Florida (now replaced by The Simpsons Ride), and The Simpsons Ride exists at both park locations, the specific characterization of being "adjacent to Springfield" applies uniquely to the Universal Studios Hollywood location. Universal Studios Florida does have a Springfield themed area, but the passages do not establish the same adjacency relationship between Springfield and The Simpsons Ride at the Florida location.
